title: Expert Regulatory Office
description:
**Department:** Regulatory Office, Portfolio \& Technology Development (P\&TD)
**Location:** Italy, Vittorio Veneto
**Job type:** Full\-time
**Role scope:** Global \- on site
**Employment:** Permanent**Role description**
--------------------


The mission of the Expert Regulatory Office is to ensure that Habasit products, materials, documentation, and customer\-facing compliance statements meet applicable regulatory requirements and internal governance standards.  

  

  

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

  

  

**Regulatory compliance and product documentation**

* Assess regulatory requirements relevant to Habasit products, materials, and applications, including food\-contact, chemical, environmental, and customer\-specific compliance requirements where applicable.
* Prepare, review, maintain, and approve regulatory documents such as declarations, compliance statements, certificates, questionnaire responses, and internal regulatory assessments.
  

  

**Customer, sales, and application support**

* Provide expert responses to regulatory questions from Sales, Customer Care, Product Management, and technical experts.
* Clarify customer requirements, interpret regulatory requests, and provide pragmatic guidance on what Habasit can confirm, certify, or clarify.
  

  

**Regulatory monitoring and risk management**

* Monitor relevant regulatory developments and assess their potential impact on Habasit products, materials, suppliers, and customer industries.
* Clarify customer requirements, interpret regulatory requests, and provide pragmatic guidance on what Habasit can confirm, certify, or clarify.
**What we look for**
--------------------

  

  

**Your education and experience**

* Degree in chemistry, materials science, polymer science, engineering, regulatory affairs, food\-contact materials, or related field, (3 years degree).
* Minimum of 3 years experience in regulatory affairs, product compliance, chemical/material compliance, quality, product development, or a comparable industrial function.
* Experience with food\-contact materials, polymer materials, chemical restrictions, safety data, declarations of compliance, supplier documentation, or customer compliance requests is a strong advantage.
* Fluent in Italian (both verbal and written).
* Fluent in English (both verbal and written).
* Able to travel up to 30% of time.
  

  

**Your personality**

* Strong link to Habasit Core Values.
* Deep knowledge (Knows the products, the process and is able to prioritize tasks).
* Customer insights (Entrepreneurial attitude, curious, business driven).
* Service orientation (Results oriented, resistant to stress, able to efficiently communicate).
* Innovation (Able to think outside the box in order to improve the process).
**What we offer**
-----------------


We offer an attractive place to work and personal development in an empowered working culture. You will benefit from the expertise and opportunities of a solid global group of companies and the reputation of its products.


Is this role for you?


If you are eager to join a dynamic, innovative, and diverse company and to quickly progress while making a difference in an impact\-oriented culture, then the Expert Regulatory Office role could be a great fit.

The final date to submit your application is October 31, 2026\.

title: Reliability Maintenance Engineer
description:
**THE POSITION**
----------------

The Reliability Maintenance Engineer will join the Global Facilities \& Engineering team at our strategic production site in Noventa Padovana (PD), reporting to the Process Engineering Manager. In this role, the candidate will improve equipment reliability, optimize preventive and predictive maintenance strategies, and support the long\-term performance of process equipment, utilities and instrumentation. The role will work closely with Maintenance, Production, Quality, HSE and global engineering stakeholders to reduce failures, improve asset availability and support compliant manufacturing operations.  



**Tasks \& Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Analyze equipment performance, failure history and maintenance data to identify reliability improvement opportunities and recurring issues.
* Develop, optimize and periodically review preventive, predictive and condition\-based maintenance strategies for process equipment, utilities and instrumentation.
* Lead or support root cause analysis, FMEA, RCM and bad actor analysis, defining corrective and preventive actions to prevent failure recurrence.
* Monitor and report reliability indicators such as equipment availability, MTBF, MTTR, maintenance backlog and preventive maintenance effectiveness.
* Support quality processes, including deviations, CAPA management and technical investigations related to maintenance and equipment reliability.
* Ensure accurate and effective use of the CMMS, contributing to asset master data management, maintenance plans, task lists, spare parts strategy and technical documentation.
* Support spare parts warehouse management, including critical spare parts identification, stock level optimization, obsolescence management and coordination with maintenance and procurement teams.
Collaborate with maintenance supervisors, technicians, production teams, quality functions and project engineering to improve equipment lifecycle performance and total cost of ownership.  
* 

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Automation Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Approximately two years of experience in reliability engineering, maintenance engineering or manufacturing engineering within a regulated industrial environment.
* Good knowledge of maintenance and reliability methodologies, including RCA, FMEA, RCM, preventive maintenance optimization and condition\-based monitoring.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools and ability to analyze maintenance data and reliability indicators.
* Fluency in Italian and Good knowledge of English, at least B2 level.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proactive and continuous improvement mindset.
* Experience with biopharma or pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
* Familiar with GxP regulatory requirements, deviation management, CAPA processes and equipment lifecycle documentation and SAP CMMS
* Knowledge of Lean methodologies, TPM implementation
* Experience with predictive maintenance technologies such as vibration analysis, thermography, oil analysis or ultrasonic inspection.
Familiarity with GoTrack or similar quality management systems.  
* 

**What we offer**
-----------------

* For this position we offer a 2\-years temporary contract.
* The gross annual base salary foreseen for this position ranges from €37\.000 to €43\.000, depending on candidate's skills and experience.
* Free access to the company canteen.
* A range of benefits for physical, financial, social and mental wellbeing.
A support to develop professional and personal paths including our full range of development programs.  
* 

We warmly welcome applications from candidates belonging to protected categories, in accordance with Law 68/99\.


We foster a workplace built on respect, trust, and empathy—free from discrimination. We are powered by our people, and we believe that our differences are our strengths. Everyone is valued, respected and empowered to be themselves.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
**Impresoft Engage** è una realtà unica nel panorama italiano, che nasce con l'obiettivo di connettere le aziende al cliente di domani stabilendo un legame forte e duraturo. Mettiamo al centro l'esperienza del cliente tramite la creazione di ambienti digitali capaci di integrare persone, processi e dati.

  

Le nostre soluzioni personalizzate, che spaziano dai processi e dalle tecnologie di CRM alla strategia digitale, dalla marketing automation ai processi di vendita online e offline passando per il Customer Service Management, consentono alle aziende di ottimizzare i processi e soddisfare le esigenze del cliente.

  

Facciamo parte del **Gruppo Impresoft**, che ècostituito da un insieme di aziende specializzate e complementari che declina la propria offerta in 4 Competence Center: Business Solutions, Smart Manufacturing \& Quality, Customer First e Enabling Technologies \& Security. Le sinergie generate da queste integrazioni, unitamente alla combinazione di talenti, competenze, soluzioni e servizi, hanno permesso al gruppo di costruire un portfolio di offerta senza eguali sul mercato per accompagnare le aziende nel loro percorso di trasformazione digitale.

  

Nell’ambito del nostro percorso di crescita e di posizionamento quale polo di innovazione digitale di Impresoft, siamo alla ricerca di un/una **Marketing Specialist**.

  

  

**Posizione:**
--------------

La persona che stiamo cercando contribuirà direttamente allo sviluppo e all'esecuzione delle strategie di marketing di Impresoft Engage e delle sue Practice. Lavorerà a stretto contatto con la CMO, i team Sales e Delivery e gestirà la collaborazione con partner e agenzie esterne.


L'obiettivo principale del ruolo è supportare la crescita del business attraverso campagne integrate e misurabili, ottimizzando il Customer Journey e la lead generation con un approccio data\-driven.

  

Di cosa ti occuperai:

  

* Campagne e Lead Generation: Progettare, pianificare e gestire campagne multicanale (Email, Social, Digital ADV, Landing Page) per la generazione di lead qualificati e la copertura del funnel.
* Marketing Automation \& CRM: Utilizzo di HubSpot per l'impostazione di workflow di marketing automation, lead nurturing e gestione database.
* Content Marketing \& Visibilità: Produzione e adattamento di contenuti ad alto valore (articoli, case study, DEM, presentazioni) applicando logiche SEO e AEO per migliorare la visibilità organica e il posizionamento di thought leadership.
* Eventi e Iniziative di Engagement: Supporto all'organizzazione e gestione operativa di webinar, eventi fisici ed eventi terzi.
* Analisi e Reportistica: Monitoraggio dei KPI di campagna e delle metriche di funnel, interpretando i dati per proporre ottimizzazioni continue.
* Gestione Assets e Stakeholder: Coordinamento con fornitori/agenzie esterne e manutenzione aggiornata degli asset digitali del brand (sito web e materiali di marketing).

**Requisiti:**
--------------

**Esperienza**: Almeno 2 anni di esperienza maturati in ruoli marketing B2B, preferibilmente in ambiti Tech, SaaS o Servizi Digitali.

 **Conoscenze Tecniche**:

  

* Solida conoscenza dei fondamenti di B2B Marketing e Demand Generation.
* Uso operativo fluido di piattaforme CRM / Marketing Automation (preferibilmente HubSpot).
* Competenze operative di Content Marketing, SEO e AEO.
* Conoscenza di strumenti di Digital Advertising (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads) e Analytics/Reporting.
* Familiarità con le logiche di Customer Journey B2B e Funnel di vendita.

 **Soft Skills**:

  

* Forte orientamento ai risultati e mentalità data\-driven.
* Curiosità, proattività e spinta all'aggiornamento continuo (con particolare interesse per l'Intelligenza Artificiale applicata al Marketing).
* Buone doti relazionali, comunicative e attitudine al lavoro in team cross\-funzionali.
* Capacità di Project Management di base (gestione priorità, tempistiche e interazione con stakeholder).
* Precisione e attenzione ai dettagli.

**Altre informazioni:**
-----------------------

Cosa offriamo

  

* RAL 23\.000 \- 30\.000
* CCNL Metalmeccanica Piccola Industria Confimi codice cnel C01A
* ambiente collaborativo e dinamico
* possibilità di svolgere la mansione anche da remoto dopo un primo periodo di inserimento
* fiducia e rispetto per idee ed opinioni: nel nostro team ognuno è libero di condividere e proporre nuove idee e soluzioni
* corsi di formazione
* obiettivi SMART
* welfare aziendale
